notes: The constructor mints the entire fixed 1e27-unit supply to the deployer. The launch factory handles the 90% pool seed and the 10% swarm distribution. Transfers from the fixed PoolManager to other addresses pay a 3% creator tax, rounded down to token minor units; transfers to the PoolManager and ordinary wallet transfers are untaxed. No owner or administrative functions exist. The launch factory configures the 1.25% pool fee and derives the opening price from economics and deployed currency order.
